notes.title: Demo version is live!
notes.content:
We prepared the new Demo version with the feedback we received from users.

What's been done
- Language support increased to 11 languages
- Refreshed interface buttons
- Fixed bugs in some sections

In the meantime, we have also made arrangements on our store page and we are ready for Steam NextFest!

notes.title: Demo version of our game will be with you soon!
notes.content:
The demo version has been submitted for Steam review and is awaiting approval. When approved, we will publish it immediately.

The demo version includes Main Stage - Chapter Selection Map - Introductory chapter - 2 normal chapters and 1 chapter of finding the same objects.
